title: Property-(P) filtration of a right DG module
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with the associative unital DG algebras, right DG modules, underlying complexes and homogeneous right action of [def-sfb-dg-derived-category]. For a right DG module $P$ over $A$, a property-(P) filtration is a sequence of DG modules $F_p$, injective DG maps $e_p:F_p\to P$, DG maps $i_p:F_p\to F_{p+1}$ satisfying $e_{p+1}i_p=e_p$, with $F_0=0$ and every homogeneous element of $P$ in some image $e_p$. Each $i_p$ has a degree-zero additive right $A$-linear left inverse, not required to commute with the differential. Give DG modules $L_p$ and degreewise surjective DG maps $F_{p+1}\to L_p$ whose kernels are the images of $i_p$. Give sets $J_p$ in the component-module universe $u$, integers $k_{pj}$ and additive equivalences $L_p^n\cong\bigoplus_{j\in J_p}A^{n+k_{pj}}$. In these coordinates the differential is $(dx)_j=(-1)^{k_{pj}}d_A(x_j)$ and right action is $(xa)_j=x_ja$, using canonical degree reassociations. Thus $L_p\cong\bigoplus_j A[k_{pj}]$ as DG modules. Empty index sets and arbitrary integer shifts are permitted. Say $P$ has property (P) if such a filtration exists.
